newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close lower, further falls seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close lower, further falls seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Tuesday as liquidity loosened in the banking system, and dealers said they expected further falls on Wednesday.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.751 percent against Monday's 5.874 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.70-5.80 percent against 5.85-5.90.

The central bank's recent fund injections through open market operations have eased tight liquidity. Some dealers predicted further falls in money rates, saying money demand ahead of the February 7 lunar Chinese new year was weaker than anticipated due to the economy's persistent sluggishness.
The government bond yields fell. Dealers said the 86/4 bond yield could test 6.10 percent on Wednesday.
